summary.name: The Clipboard Project
summary.one_liner: The Clipboard Project (CB) is a free, open clipboard manager with a command-line interface for copying text and files and managing multiple clipboards.
use_cases: copy text or files from the terminal
quick copy and paste across apps
summary.what_it_does: The page describes CB as a fast, lightweight clipboard manager operated mainly through a `cb` command. Users can copy text, files, and folders with commands like `cb copy`, and create multiple separate clipboards. Clipboard contents can be manipulated with regular expressions and scripted. The page says it is free and does not invade privacy, and it links to a GitHub repository with detailed help and a wiki.
notable: Command-line `cb` tool for copying text, files and folders
Multiple independent clipboards manipulable with full regex
Installable via one-line curl or PowerShell convenience scripts
Open source project hosted on GitHub with a wiki and Discord
caveats: Platform list is inferred: the page names Windows and non-Windows install scripts, but only explicitly mentions Windows; Linux and macOS are not named in the page text
Install relies on running remote scripts piped to a shell
